speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The light is brought into the temple, brethren. We shall be brief.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Candlemas. Sit as if you had come for it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A candle is a small sun, and it is spent. Consider the spending.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are considering the owl. I know the face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The owl is delivered. I am here.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And so to the table. The light, and then the bread.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Communion. Both hands. We are not at a play.
